note: Cirrus Labs (founded 2017 by Fedor Korotkov, bootstrapped, never raised outside capital) builds Tart (Apple Virtualization.framework VM manager) and Orchard (orchestrator). On 2026-04-07 Cirrus Labs agreed to join OpenAI's Agent Infrastructure team. As a result: Cirrus CI (its SaaS CI/CD product) shut down 2026-06-01; Cirrus Runners stopped accepting new customers; Tart/Vetu/Orchard were relicensed under the more permissive FSL-1.1-ALv2 and all paid licensing fees for them were dropped (now free for internal use, no core/worker caps). The tart.run/licensing page still shows stale paid tiers (Gold/Platinum/Diamond) from before the change. Project development continues under github.com/openai/tart. Buyers should treat this purely as a free, OpenAI-maintained open/source-available self-hosted tool rather than a paid vendor with its own funding trajectory going forward.
